questions.prompt: You connect Google Drive to ChatGPT. Which files can its plugin work with?

options.text: Every file in the company's Drive
options.explanation: The ChatGPT docs say signing in doesn't unlock other files or add Google Drive permissions.

options.text: Files your own account can already open
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI: the plugin works with documents your account can already access.

options.text: Only files you upload into the chat
options.explanation: The plugin can work across Drive, but only inside what your account can open.

questions.prompt: What does OpenAI's Enterprise guide say to turn on first?

options.explanation: Right. OpenAI: start with read actions, then add write actions after review.
The ChatGPT docs ask for an owner, a scope review and a recovery path before write actions.
The ChatGPT docs say to start with read actions, not everything at once.

questions.prompt: Gemini's answer quotes an email. Why open the source before you act?

options.text: Sources are only shown to admins
options.explanation: The Gemini Apps Help tells every user to review the sources listed after the response.

options.text: Each source costs extra to open
options.explanation: No page says that. The Gemini Apps Help tells you to click and review the sources listed after the response.

options.text: It may use an older email by mistake
options.explanation: Right. The Gemini Apps Help says Gemini can give outdated information, like from an older email, and says to check the sources.
